toolbar.line.tooltip: Line (B): Click the bus stops of a line in the order the bus serves them; the way over the map's roads shows at once. Make the return trip from other stops, close a ring, lead the way over another road with waypoints, and save the line.
line.title: Line
line.hint: Click the bus stops (bus_stop.sco) on the map in the order the bus serves them. The way over the vehicle lanes is shown as you go.
line.name: Line name
line.mode.out.tooltip: The stops of the first direction
line.mode.back.tooltip: The stops of the way back; other stops, one way streets and other roads are possible
line.ring.tooltip: A ring line ends where it begins and has no return: click the first stop again, or tick this
line.waypoint.tooltip: Click a road to make the bus pass it, without a stop there
line.stop.new.tooltip: A stop not in the timetable yet: type its name
line.copy.tooltip: Takes the stops of the outbound trip in reverse as the return trip
line.clear.tooltip: Removes all stops of this direction
line.save.tooltip: Writes the line, its trips, the station links and new stops; the timetable editor opens next for the departures
line.network: Reading the roads of the map...

line.status.waypoint_first: Click a stop first; a waypoint leads the way between stops.
line.status.waypoint_off: A waypoint must lie on a road for vehicles.
line.status.need_route: Every stop of a direction needs a way; see the result.
